svg.title: Time-forced switch simulation traces
svg.desc: The fast and slow locations alternate at rising dwell-clock crossings. x1 and x2 decay continuously with different rates in each location. The lower panel shows exact clock resets to zero at every switch, without connecting pre- and post-reset samples.
